arxiv-1710-07508.creator: \firstname Christoph \lastname Blume \fnsep
arxiv-1710-07508.description: Abstract Open questions concerning strangeness production in heavy-ion collisions are discussed with a focus on the experimental aspects. The open points are presented in the context of recent measurements. 1 Introduction The following is an attempt to compile a list of the most important open topics concerning strangeness production in heavy-ion physics.

arxiv-1906-08946.title: Appliance of network theory in economic geography
arxiv-1906-08946.creator: Alexandra Barina, Gabriel Barina and Mihai Udrescu
arxiv-1906-08946.description: Abstract A continuously evolving geography requires a good understanding in networks. As such, this paper accounts for theories and applications of complex networks and their role both in geography in general, as well as in determining various geographical network trajectories.

arxiv-2305-20005.title: τ \tau data-driven evaluation of Euclidean windows for the hadronic vacuum polarization
arxiv-2305-20005.creator: Pere Masjuan, Alejandro Miranda, Pablo Roig
arxiv-2305-20005.description: Abstract We compute for the first time the τ \tau data-driven Euclidean windows for the hadronic vacuum polarization contribution to the muon g − 2 g-2 . We show that τ \tau -based results agree with the available lattice window evaluations and with the full result.

arxiv-2403-08275.title: Fully discrete finite difference schemes for the Fractional Korteweg-de Vries equation
arxiv-2403-08275.creator: Mukul Dwivedi, Tanmay Sarkar
arxiv-2403-08275.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mukul Dwivedi, Tanmay Sarkar. In this paper, we present and analyze fully discrete finite difference schemes designed for solving the initial value problem associated with the fractional Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation involving the fractional Laplacian. We design the scheme by introducing the discrete fractional Laplacian operator which is consistent with the continuous operator, and posses certain properties which are instrumental for the convergence analysis.

arxiv-2507-11333.description: Abstract Learning-based Multi-View Stereo (MVS) methods aim to predict depth maps for a sequence of calibrated images to recover dense point clouds. However, existing MVS methods often struggle with challenging regions, such as textureless regions and reflective surfaces, where feature matching fails.

pmc-11586728.creator: Bishav Mohan, Akash Batta
pmc-11586728.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The deleterious effects of long term right ventricular pacing are increasingly being recognized today. Current clinical practice favors the implantation of dual-chamber permanent pacemaker which maintains atrioventricular synchrony and is associated with better quality of life. However, despite the popular belief and common sense surrounding the superiority of dual-chamber pacing over single chamber pacing, the same has never been conclusively verified in clinical trials.
